headlines.title: 서울 집주인, 재산세 5119억 더 냈다 [H-EXCLUSIVE]
headlines.summary: 2026년 서울시 주택 재산세 현황 총 3조8961억원…전년比 15.1% 증가 집값·공시가 상승 영향에 세 부담↑ 강남 등 공시가 12억 초과 42% 급등 12억 이하 주택은 8.7% 가량 줄어 올해 서울 주택분 재산세 관련 세액이 5000억원 이상 늘어난 가운데 증가분 상당수가 공시가격 12억 초과 주택에 집중된 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 재산세 증가분 57%가 강남3구 …‘공시가 12억 초과 ’ 한강벨트만 65만채
headlines.summary: 서울 재산세 증가 5119억, 강남3구 2920억↑ 강남3구 재산세 1.7조…서울 전체 44% 차지 동작 210% 상승 등 고가주택 강남 넘어 확산 집값 상승·공시가 인상, 한강변 세부담 확대 서울 중구 남산공원에서 바라본 강남·서초 일대의 아파트 단지의 모습.

headlines.title: " 부동산 세금 , 너무 어려워 "…국세청에 양도세 질의 2배 급증
headlines.summary: 올해 1∼7월 국세청에 접수된 부동산 관련 세금 질의 지난해 전체의 90% 넘어 양도·종부·상증세 질의 총 2726건 올해 부동산 세금에 대한 문의가 급격히 늘어난 것으로 나타났다. 정부의 다주택자 양도세 중과 재개와 장기보유특별공제 등 부동산 세제를 손질하면서 납세자의 불확실성을 키웠다는 지적이다. 특히 양도소득세 질의는 지난해의 2배 가까이로 늘었다.

headlines.title: 반도체 이익, 반도체 투자에만 집중 … 체감 안되는 호황
headlines.summary: 올해 설비투자 7.9% 증가 전망 경제 전반으로 성장 온기 안퍼져 반도체 호황이 기업 이익과 세수는 빠르게 끌어올리고 있지만 임금과 국내 투자로 번지는 속도는 이를 따라가지 못하고 있다. 반도체 중심 성장의 과실이 경제 전반으로 확산되지 못하면서 수출·성장 지표와 체감경기 간 괴리가 커지고 있다는 지적이 나온다.

headlines.title: 관세청, 반도체 공정용 가스 조절장비 ‘ 무관세 결정 ’
headlines.summary: 관세청이 품목 분류 기준을 정비해 그간 3% 관세가 부과됐던 반도체 제조공정용 가스압력 조절 장비를 무관세 품목으로 결정했다. 관세청은 지난달 13일 열린 ‘2026년 5회 관세품목분류위원회’에서 총 9건의 품목분류를 결정했으며, 이를 반영한 ‘수출입물품 등에 대한 품목분류 변경고시’ 개정안을 14일 관보에 게재했다고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 韓 경기선행지수, 75개월 만에 17개국 중 1위 … 오름폭은 둔화
headlines.summary: 8월 102.87…5년3개월 만에 최고 지난해 2월부터 19개월 연속 상승 작년 9월 16위에서 올해 1위로 월 상승폭은 0.43→0.06포인트 [대구=뉴시스] 이무열 기자 = 제80주년 광복절인 15일 대구의 한 아파트에 태극기가 게양돼 있다. 2025.08.15. lmy@newsis.

headlines.title: 9~10월 도입 물량 원유 90% 확보했지만 …‘ 비축유 스와프 ’ 총동원

headlines.summary: 연준 금리인상 확률 85.8%로 급등 원화 약세에 고유가까지 ‘이중 충격’ 한은 내달 금통위 추가 인상 주목 미국의 고용과 물가 지표가 잇달아 시장 예상을 웃돌면서 15~16일(현지시간) 열리는 연방공개시장위원회(FOMC)에서 기준금리가 인상될 가능성이 커지고 있다.

headlines.title: “ 비싼 한우는 구경만 ”… 수입 삼겹살 소비 49% 급증
headlines.summary: 1~7월 국산 소고기 판매량 6.6%↓ 수입 돼지 전 부위 2년 새 69.9%↑ 고물가 부담에 육류도 가성비 따져 “요즘 한우는 눈으로만 봅니다.” 퇴근길 마트를 찾은 A씨가 수입산 삼겹살 코너로 이동하면서 말했다. 그는 “당연히 한우를 사고 싶지만, 식비 부담이 늘어 삼겹살을 택하는 날이 많아졌다”고 했다.

top5_headlines.title: 관세청, 반도체 공정용 가스 조절장비 ‘ 무관세 결정 ’
top5_headlines.summary: 관세청이 품목 분류 기준을 정비해 그간 3% 관세가 부과됐던 반도체 제조공정용 가스압력 조절 장비를 무관세 품목으로 결정했다. 관세청은 지난달 13일 열린 ‘2026년 5회 관세품목분류위원회’에서 총 9건의 품목분류를 결정했으며, 이를 반영한 ‘수출입물품 등에 대한 품목분류 변경고시’ 개정안을 14일 관보에 게재했다고 밝혔다.

top5_headlines.title: 美금리인상, 유가·환율 상승 … 한은 ‘ 금리 인상 ’ 이어가나
top5_headlines.summary: 연준 금리인상 확률 85.8%로 급등 원화 약세에 고유가까지 ‘이중 충격’ 한은 내달 금통위 추가 인상 주목 미국의 고용과 물가 지표가 잇달아 시장 예상을 웃돌면서 15~16일(현지시간) 열리는 연방공개시장위원회(FOMC)에서 기준금리가 인상될 가능성이 커지고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: " 부동산 세금 , 너무 어려워 "…국세청에 양도세 질의 2배 급증
top5_headlines.summary: 올해 1∼7월 국세청에 접수된 부동산 관련 세금 질의 지난해 전체의 90% 넘어 양도·종부·상증세 질의 총 2726건 올해 부동산 세금에 대한 문의가 급격히 늘어난 것으로 나타났다. 정부의 다주택자 양도세 중과 재개와 장기보유특별공제 등 부동산 세제를 손질하면서 납세자의 불확실성을 키웠다는 지적이다. 특히 양도소득세 질의는 지난해의 2배 가까이로 늘었다.

top5_headlines.title: 반도체 이익, 반도체 투자에만 집중 … 체감 안되는 호황
top5_headlines.summary: 올해 설비투자 7.9% 증가 전망 경제 전반으로 성장 온기 안퍼져 반도체 호황이 기업 이익과 세수는 빠르게 끌어올리고 있지만 임금과 국내 투자로 번지는 속도는 이를 따라가지 못하고 있다. 반도체 중심 성장의 과실이 경제 전반으로 확산되지 못하면서 수출·성장 지표와 체감경기 간 괴리가 커지고 있다는 지적이 나온다.

top5_headlines.title: 韓 경기선행지수, 75개월 만에 17개국 중 1위 … 오름폭은 둔화
top5_headlines.summary: 8월 102.87…5년3개월 만에 최고 지난해 2월부터 19개월 연속 상승 작년 9월 16위에서 올해 1위로 월 상승폭은 0.43→0.06포인트 [대구=뉴시스] 이무열 기자 = 제80주년 광복절인 15일 대구의 한 아파트에 태극기가 게양돼 있다. 2025.08.15. lmy@newsis.

key_headlines.title: Customs Service Eliminates Tariffs on Semiconductor Process Gas Control Equipment
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's Customs Service reclassified semiconductor manufacturing gas pressure control equipment as tariff-free, removing the previous 3% tariff that had been imposed. This decision was announced after the September Tariff Classification Committee meeting and published in the official gazette on September 14.

key_headlines.title: Fed Rate Hike Probability Surges to 85.8% Amid Concerns Over US Employment and Inflation
key_headlines.summary: The likelihood of a Federal Reserve rate increase at the upcoming FOMC meeting (September 15-16) has jumped significantly as US employment and inflation data continue to exceed market expectations. This development creates pressure on the Bank of Korea to continue with rate hikes amid rising oil prices and weak Korean won.

key_headlines.title: Real Estate Tax Inquiries to National Tax Service Double Year-over-Year
key_headlines.summary: Inquiries about real estate-related taxes at the National Tax Service surged to over 90% of last year's total during the first seven months of 2026, with capital gains tax queries nearly doubling. The increase reflects uncertainty created by government policy changes including renewed capital gains taxes on multi-property owners and adjustments to long-term holding deductions.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Boom Concentrated in Chip Sector; Economic Benefits Not Spreading Broadly
key_headlines.summary: While semiconductor profits are accelerating corporate earnings and tax revenue, the benefits are not translating into wage increases or broader domestic investments. Equipment investment is projected to grow only 7.9% this year, creating a disconnect between export statistics and consumer sentiment.

key_headlines.title: South Korea's Economic Leading Index Ranks First Among 17 Countries After 75 Months
key_headlines.summary: Korea's August economic leading index reached 102.87, the highest in five years and three months, ranking first globally among 17 countries after 19 consecutive months of increases. However, the monthly growth rate has slowed from 0.43 to 0.06 percentage points, indicating moderating momentum.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing mixed signals as semiconductor profits surge to record levels, with the Bank of Korea raising its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 3.3% and 2027 to 2.9%. However, the benefits of this semiconductor boom remain concentrated in the chip sector, with wages and domestic investments not keeping pace with corporate profit growth. The disconnect between strong export performance and weak consumer sentiment is becoming increasingly apparent. Additionally, the government's revisions to real estate tax policies have created significant uncertainty, as evidenced by a doubling of tax-related inquiries to the National Tax Service. The economy faces headwinds from rising international oil prices and potential Federal Reserve rate increases that could pressure Korean asset markets.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's economic outlook has improved significantly, with major institutions including the Bank of Korea and Moody's raising growth forecasts for 2026 to the 3.2-3.5% range. Corporate tax revenues are projected to exceed 216.7 trillion won in 2027, surpassing personal income taxes for the first time in 15 years, driven by the semiconductor sector boom. However, employment gains are highly polarized, with recent job creation concentrated among workers aged 60 and older, resulting in record low unemployment rates that mask structural labor market challenges. France has downgraded its economic growth outlook due to extreme weather and drought impacts. The government is addressing emerging concerns about real estate tax complexity and market stability through various policy coordination mechanisms.
sections.Financial Markets: Global financial markets are experiencing significant volatility as the US 10-year Treasury yield approaches 5% and crude oil prices surpass 100 dollars per barrel, creating dual pressures on asset valuations. The probability of a Federal Reserve rate hike this week has surged to 85.8% following stronger-than-expected US employment and inflation data. Strong US employment figures, with non-farm payrolls jumping 162,000 in August compared to a 56,000 forecast, suggest persistent inflation pressures despite Fed efforts at monetary tightening. The Korean won has weakened against the dollar amid expectations of a widening US-Korea interest rate differential if the Fed proceeds with rate increases. South Korea's financial authorities are monitoring developments closely and coordinating policy responses through the F4 meeting scheduled for September 17.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's semiconductor supply chain is experiencing robust growth, with companies like Ecopro HN expanding global contracts in advanced packaging and high-bandwidth memory materials while diversifying into battery and energy sectors. LG Chem has signed a memorandum of understanding with Chinese firm Zhuanghuawei for high-purity semiconductor cleaning materials, marking significant collaboration in precision chemical supply chains. Solid-state battery research is advancing, with successful low-pressure operation demonstrated on batteries maintaining 72.4% capacity after 200 charge-discharge cycles using high-energy-density NCM811 cathodes. The semiconductor materials sector is witnessing accelerated internationalization and technology advancement driven by global demand for next-generation chip manufacturing.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices are on an 83-week consecutive rally, approaching the record 85-week streak from the previous administration, with rental deposits rising for six consecutive months. Multi-property tax policy revisions and semiconductor investment announcements are creating speculative pressure in various regions, with Gwangju experiencing nine consecutive weeks of price increases following the selection of its military airfield as a national semiconductor industrial park candidate. High-end monthly rental prices exceeding 3 million won, previously concentrated in Gangnam, are now spreading to other Seoul districts as the gap between purchase prices and rental costs widens. Lender and tenant affordability concerns are mounting as both rental deposits and monthly rental payments increase simultaneously, driven by tight full-lease inventory and conversion to partial-lease arrangements.
sections.International Economy: US President Trump has intensified pressure on the Federal Reserve ahead of this week's FOMC meeting, threatening trade restrictions against deficit countries if rate cuts are not implemented, warning of potential impacts on international commerce. Canada is strategically shifting its economic focus toward Europe amid escalating US trade tensions, pursuing quasi-membership status in the EU to strengthen economic resilience. Trump has explicitly warned of potential withdrawal from USMCA if the Fed does not comply with rate reduction demands, creating uncertainty for Korean companies with US operations. The Fed is balancing Trump's political pressure with traditional monetary policy mandates as inflation and employment data support rate increases rather than cuts.
sections.AI & Economy: SK AX received a Korean Ministry of Employment and Labor award for innovative AI capability verification systems that enhanced employee productivity and work practices, demonstrating corporate implementation of AI-augmented operations. Leading mathematicians, including Fields Medal recipients, have warned that AI companies' focus on solving mathematical problems risks harming mathematics research and academia by emphasizing computational speed over genuine mathematical understanding. South Korea is at an inflection point transitioning from a 30-year fast-follower strategy to a leading economy role in the AI era, requiring fundamental shifts in innovation and R&D approaches. Oracle's aggressive AI data center investment announcements have boosted server manufacturers Dell and Hewlett Packard Enterprise stock prices by approximately 12%, reflecting market enthusiasm for AI infrastructure expansion.
sections.Others: Lotte and KAIST have completed construction of a joint R&D center in Daejeon with 10 billion won in Lotte funding, focusing on AI-based biotech, carbon-neutral energy, and healthcare technology development. Concerns about an AI speed-reduction movement have been addressed by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's clarifications, following Trump's warnings that slowing AI development could harm competitiveness and the US economy. AI developers face a prisoner's dilemma situation where individual companies cannot afford to slow development speeds despite recognizing potential risks, as competitors cannot be trusted to exercise restraint. LG's foundation AI models are enabling rapid problem-solving in industrial applications, such as identifying hair loss prevention compounds in a single day, demonstrating practical AI deployment beyond research environments.
